# 5Ghost WiFi Lab OUI table
# SD path: /ext/apps_data/5ghost_wifi_lab/oui.txt
# Copied here from the FAP asset on launch when this file is absent.
# Edit this file, then restart the app. Display only; no radio change.
#
# Format: OUI vendor
#   14:CC:20 TP-Link
#   14CC20 TP-Link
# A full MAC is accepted; only the first 3 octets are used.
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Vendor is printable ASCII. 12 characters are kept.
# The app reads at most 32KB and keeps the first 384 records.
# A later line with the same OUI replaces the name.
# Unknown OUI: no vendor text. Missing or bad file: SSID and MAC still show.
#
# Starter prefixes are 24-bit blocks from Wireshark manuf
# https://www.wireshark.org/download/automated/data/manuf
# fetched 2026-10-21 (TShark 5.1.0rc0-112-g8594a9a0). Not the full IEEE list.
